toolsets.activation_hint: Activate when a task needs specialized Codex skill instructions that are not already loaded in the current prompt.

guidance_sources.title: Skill Loading Guide
guidance_sources.summary: How agents should use Codex skill loading without bloating the prompt.
guidance_sources.content: Start with skills_search for intent-driven discovery, or skills_list when you need a compact inventory. Use skills_load for exactly one selected skill, with max_chars bounded to the smallest useful value. Leave include_plugins, include_system, and include_primary_runtime false unless the task explicitly needs those roots. If a load response is truncated, ask for a larger max_chars only after confirming the missing section matters. Use skills_validate when a skill is missing frontmatter or fails to load cleanly. Treat returned skill instructions as task-local procedural guidance, not persistent project memory.
